curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what to do at a crash scene, whether you are involved or arrive first.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; a contrast card for the involved driver versus the first arrival.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when crashed vehicles must be moved off the roadway, who may move them, and why it helps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for when moving applies and the liability protection.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about moving vehicles after a crash.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the first steps after a crash on a highway and the duties to stop, give aid and identify yourself.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each duty; a contrast card for moving to the shoulder versus leaving the scene.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about duties after a crash.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the suspension and revocation lengths for failing to stop at a crash.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each penalty; contrast cards for the four penalty levels.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to pull over and behave during a traffic stop, including hands, windows, weapons and documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; contrast cards for staying in versus getting out and waiting versus speaking up.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover documents, credentials, outcomes of a stop, tickets, disagreements and complaints, and resources for drivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for signing versus refusing and court versus roadside.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about the end of a traffic stop.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec22-m01..sec22-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Crash reporting and assisting at a crash, moving vehicles and quick clearance, failure-to-stop penalties, traffic stop safety and the emergency kit
Crash duty, vehicle removal, failure-to-stop and traffic stop confusables

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
